text: JVM HDF5 adapter now has real jHDF read/write for current LNA payloads, root/manifest checksum write+verify behavior, logical dtype attrs for payloads, explicit checksum rejection tests, and roundtrips quant, sd quant reports, delta/quant, basis/embed, and explicit latent archives. Verified archiveJVM/test archiveJS/test datasetJVM/test datasetJS/test compileAll. Native unsigned HDF5 integer emission is not supported by jHDF 0.12.0 writer API and should be a separate fork/native-backend task if external tools require it.
